params.body:
The panel on People was a grid of toggles that all looked alike. It now uses plain controls, each saying what it does.

- **Plan on gentells.com:** a select. For a team member it is a sentence instead ("Intelligence, because Ellen is on the team. It goes back when they leave."), since it cannot be changed there.
- **Trial:** a select ("Start a trial of 7, 14 or 30 days", "End the trial now"). It is not shown for team members, who already have the top plan.
- **Observatory and Studio:** a select: Remove from the team, Member (reads and writes), Admin (also runs settings and people). For someone not on the team it reads Invite as member or Invite as admin. A pending invitation can be sent again.
- **Account:** "Active since …" with a quiet **Block this account**, which asks first and says what blocking does. A blocked account shows it in red, with Unblock.

**Fixes**
- The table cells now have padding on both sides, so a name no longer touches the tinted edge of an open row.
- A stray "0" next to the team controls is gone: React rendered `pending = 0`.

Checked: build, lint at its ceiling, e2e 28 passing.
params.title: People: a plain panel with selects and sentences; no trial for the team
